procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial session; no spawn, fork, resume, peer review or producer/planner record access. Read the pinned packet, case, rubric, review rules, selected recording method/addendum and adapter. Verified exact pinned input bytes and poster PNG dimensions, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts; the two corresponding receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact poster using tools.view_image with detail original, emitting the returned pixels, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same three-view order. All fifteen displays completed before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage or any mandatory, aesthetic or diversity judgment. First readings below come from those displayed native and usage pixels, with actual soft wraps retained; no OCR, required-copy filling, substituted asset, crop or revisit. Receipts attest to these actual displays, not helper exits or invented serialized opening events. Native dimensions are 1672x941 for every member; height differs from width*9/16 by exactly 0.5 pixel, so ratio PASS uses the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge tolerance rather than mathematically exact 16:9. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. No runtime session identity is observable here; session_id remains null.
